select store_city as name from system_store_info where store_city is not null and store_city != '' and store_source = 0
and store_city = #{dept.name}

SELECT DISTINCT a.store_id FROM system_store_info a JOIN system_org g ON a.org_id = g.id AND g.deleted = b'0' JOIN system_org_user rr ON FIND_IN_SET(rr.org_id, g.ancestors) > 0 AND rr.deleted = b'0' WHERE rr.user_id = #{userId} AND a.store_source = 0 AND a.deleted = b'0'

SELECT DISTINCT a.store_id FROM system_store_info a JOIN system_org g ON a.org_id = g.id AND g.deleted = b'0' WHERE (a.org_id = #{orgId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{orgId}, g.ancestors) > 0) AND a.deleted = b'0'

select a.store_id from system_store_info a where a.deleted = b'0' AND a.org_id in ( SELECT g.id FROM system_org g WHERE g.deleted = b'0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM system_org_user rr WHERE rr.deleted = b'0' AND rr.user_id = #{userId} AND FIND_IN_SET(rr.org_id, g.ancestors) > 0 ) )
